title: Selective Demonstration Retrieval for Improved Implicit Hate Speech Detection

bias_targets.methodology: Quantifying model 'over-sensitivity' to vulnerable demographic groups and identity terms by subtracting the Precision score of the 'hate' label from its Recall score on the Implicit Hate Corpus (IHC), assessing the rate at which models misclassify neutral or counter-hate statements containing these demographic terms as hateful.
